(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles; a thermally conductive binder selected from the group consisting of a thermally conductive epoxy and a premixed solder paste; and a solvent.

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to an electronic component surface, wherein the electronic component is a silicon chip.

(Currently Amended) Claim 3: The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent is removed during application to the electronic component surface, wherein the solvent is vaporized upon heating the electronic component surface.
